# Beard's Home Services

> Home repair, remodeling and construction in Mountain Home, Arkansas and the Twin Lakes area (Baxter County). Owner-operated by Brian Beard, 20+ years in the trades. Free estimates, no upfront payment. Call or text (870) 321-1072.

Service area: Mountain Home, Gassville, Bull Shoals, Flippin, Cotter, Lakeview and the rest of Baxter County, AR.
Hours: Monday-Friday 7am-6pm, Saturday 9am-4pm.
Payment: cash or check.

## Services

- [All services](https://beardshomeservices.com/): Overview of every service, project photos and contact details
- [Concrete work](https://beardshomeservices.com/concrete): Driveways, sidewalks, slabs, shop floors, carports, fire pits
- [Metal roofing](https://beardshomeservices.com/roofing): Metal roof installation and repair
- [Decks and porches](https://beardshomeservices.com/decks): New decks, deck upgrades, ramps and repairs
- [Bathroom remodeling](https://beardshomeservices.com/bathroom-remodel): Full remodels, tub surrounds, tile showers, vanities
- [Flooring](https://beardshomeservices.com/flooring): Luxury vinyl plank, laminate, tile and carpet
- [Handyman services](https://beardshomeservices.com/handyman): General home repair, gutters, drainage and odd jobs
